projects.title: Wiki Loves Monument UK
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive full-stack data visualization application from end-to-end, highlighting individual contributions to the Wiki Loves Monuments UK competition. Utilized the D3.js library to create interactive charts and maps, showcasing the extensive dataset containing more than 300,000 items across the competition's 12-year history.
projects.descriptionZh: 端到端开发了一个全栈数据可视化应用，展示 Wiki Loves Monuments UK 摄影大赛的个人贡献。基于 D3.js 构建交互式图表与地图，呈现超过 30 万条、跨越 12 年历史的竞赛数据集。

detail.lead: Data Visualisation Platform for Wiki Loves Monument UK, the world's largest photo competition.
detail.leadZh: 为全球最大摄影竞赛 Wiki Loves Monuments UK 构建的数据可视化平台。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Developed a comprehensive full-stack data visualisation application from end-to-end, highlighting individual contributions to the Wiki Loves Monuments UK competition. Utilised the d3.js library to create interactive charts and maps, showcasing the extensive dataset containing more than 300,000 items across the competition's 12-year history.
sections.bodyZh: 端到端开发了全栈数据可视化应用，呈现 Wiki Loves Monuments UK 竞赛的个人贡献。使用 D3.js 构建交互式图表与地图，展示超过 30 万条、横跨 12 年的竞赛历史数据。

sections.heading: My role
sections.body: I assumed full ownership of the project, managing every phase from initial data collection to backend development, and ultimately, creating a compelling frontend experience. My responsibilities encompassed gathering and processing data, as well as designing and implementing data visualisation and storytelling features that brought the dataset to life.
sections.bodyZh: 全程独立负责项目，从数据采集到后端开发，再到前端交互体验的完整构建。负责数据整理与处理，以及数据可视化与叙事功能的设计与实现，赋予数据集生命力。

sections.heading: Tech stack
sections.body: Leveraged Next.js for front-end development, d3.js for dynamic data visualisation, Django (Python) as the web framework for backend operations, and SQLite for database management. Next.js uses both React and Node.js to offer a comprehensive framework that simplifies the development of fast, scalable, and SEO-friendly web applications.
sections.bodyZh: 前端使用 Next.js，数据可视化使用 D3.js，后端采用 Django（Python）Web 框架，数据库使用 SQLite。Next.js 结合 React 与 Node.js，提供了一套高效、可扩展且对 SEO 友好的全栈开发框架。

sections.heading: Impact
sections.body: The application is expected to significantly boost participation in the competition, enhance public knowledge of the Wiki Loves Monuments project, and raise awareness of UK monuments. By making these contributions visible and engaging, the project aims to foster a deeper connection between the community and UK's cultural heritage.
sections.bodyZh: 该应用有望显著提升竞赛参与度，加深公众对 Wiki Loves Monuments 项目的了解，并提高对英国历史古迹的关注。通过将贡献可视化并增强互动性，项目致力于深化社区与英国文化遗产之间的联系。

projects.title: Visualizing Music Trend
projects.description: Collaborated with a friend to develop a D3.js application using the Spotify Tracks Chart Dataset (2014–2023) from Kaggle, containing around 110,000 entries to analyze global music trends.
projects.descriptionZh: 与朋友合作，基于 Kaggle 上的 Spotify 曲目排行榜数据集（2014–2023，约 11 万条记录），开发了一款 D3.js 应用，用于分析全球音乐趋势。

detail.eyebrow: University of St Andrews · Case study · 2024
detail.eyebrowZh: 圣安德鲁斯大学 · 案例研究 · 2024
detail.lead: D3.js application for analyzing global music trends from 2014–2023.
detail.leadZh: 基于 D3.js 的全球音乐趋势分析应用（2014–2023）。

meta.roleZh: 联合开发者 · 前端与图表

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: My friend and I developed a D3.js music visualization application using the Spotify Tracks Chart Dataset (2014-2023) from Kaggle, which contains around 110,000 entries. The dataset includes categorical variables like track name, release date, and artists, as well as numerical data such as rankings and streams.
sections.bodyZh: 我与朋友共同开发了一款 D3.js 音乐可视化应用，数据来自 Kaggle 上的 Spotify 曲目排行榜数据集（2014–2023，约 11 万条记录）。数据集包含曲目名称、发行日期、艺人等分类变量，以及排名、播放量等数值数据。

sections.heading: My role
sections.body: I was responsible for building the project structure in HTML and Tailwind CSS, implementing the page layout, and creating all the charts using D3.js. My teammate added additional features, like linking to Wiki pages and refining the bubble chart.
sections.bodyZh: 我负责使用 HTML 与 Tailwind CSS 搭建项目结构、实现页面布局，并用 D3.js 创建所有图表。队友负责补充功能，如添加 Wiki 页面链接和优化气泡图。

sections.heading: Tech stack
sections.body: The application was developed using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and module JavaScript within one week. D3.js was used for all data visualizations, enabling rich interactive exploration of the dataset.
sections.bodyZh: 应用使用 HTML、Tailwind CSS 与模块化 JavaScript 在一周内完成开发。所有数据可视化均基于 D3.js 实现，支持丰富的交互式数据探索。

sections.heading: Impact
sections.body: Our application visually analyzes key music trends, addressing questions like which artists consistently rank in the top ten, how music streaming has evolved over time, and what the most popular genres are. This interactive tool helps users explore and understand global music trends over nearly a decade.
sections.bodyZh: 应用通过可视化分析了关键音乐趋势，回答了哪些艺人长期稳居前十、音乐流媒体如何演变以及最受欢迎的流派等问题。这一交互工具帮助用户探索并理解近十年的全球音乐趋势。
